title: Unsafe Global Mut State Mutations
pattern: Mutating global variables without synchronization or atomic ordering under multi-threaded server environments.
why_bad: Unsafe memory access, undefined behavior, and compiler optimizations that fuse stores or reorder execution paths, leading to infinite loops or incorrect program flow.
detection: Search for `unsafe` blocks writing to static variables (`static mut`) in multi-threaded application paths.
counterexample: Mutating local variables inside single-threaded loops.
